question: Approve this Task B design and its acceptance criteria into implementation?

artifacts.summary: Design for Task B, spiked on main d540a04 (142 lines, 7 unit tests, 269/269): every revealed row clears the save bar by its measured height plus 20 px; the 'N with no field picked yet' note becomes an underlined button that visits the no-field rows in order and wraps, focusing each row's pill; the Test run moves into the openProject store so it survives the 720 px remount; long names break only after underscores (<wbr>, copied text unchanged); the ≠ explanation gains 'Check it is the field you mean.'. Unpatched main fails each check except the new-row clause at 1280x1400. Design review: 6 minor, all declined. No Captain decision.
